summary: WADK is a radio station licensed to serve Newport, Rhode Island, and owned by 3G Broadcasting, Inc. The station broadcasts a News/Talk format. Jazz programming airs on weekends, and during the autumn it carries local high school football and Salve Regina University college football home games.
